name: encrust
description: Prepare a 3D model for an MSLA resin printer: orient, hollow, drain, support, check and write the printer file.
long_description: Encrust is an offline resin slicer. This extension lets your AI assistant drive it on your computer: every tool runs the encrust command line on your own files, profiles and printers on your network. Exposure comes from your own resin profiles only.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: The printers, your resins and the support profiles

tools.name: import_resin
tools.description: Takes in your resin from a file that printed well or another slicer's export

tools.name: create_resin
tools.description: Makes your resin from the numbers on its bottle

tools.name: write_test_print
tools.description: Writes a test print, such as the exposure check

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: The ways a model can be prepared, each with its steps

tools.name: inspect_model
tools.description: What a model file is and what is wrong with it

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Starts preparing a model for a printer and resin

tools.name: use_recipe
tools.description: Prepares the model by a recipe that fits what it is for

tools.name: show_in_window
tools.description: Shows the model as prepared in your Encrust window

tools.name: report_print
tools.description: Reads what went wrong with a print against its file's check

tools.name: save_recipe
tools.description: Keeps a way of preparing as your own recipe, for the window too

tools.name: compare_poses
tools.description: Shows the best ways to stand the model, each drawn

tools.name: set_pose
tools.description: Orients the model, by the search or a turn

tools.name: set_hollow
tools.description: Hollows the model, with or without infill

tools.name: set_drains
tools.description: Drills drain holes into the cavity

tools.name: set_supports
tools.description: Builds the supports the model stands on

tools.name: set_shape
tools.description: Scales, combines, labels, cuts or textures the model

tools.name: set_repair
tools.description: Repairs the model and mends faces by hand

tools.name: set_slicing
tools.description: Sets the layers, exposure bands and anti-aliasing

tools.name: set_machine
tools.description: Moves the job to the printer and resin you name

tools.name: fix_issues
tools.description: Answers what the check finds, as Check's Fix all does

tools.name: plate_jobs
tools.description: Lays several jobs on one plate, as one printer file

tools.name: check
tools.description: Checks a revision as it would print

tools.name: render
tools.description: Draws the prepared plate from each side, problems marked

tools.name: revert
tools.description: Returns to an earlier revision

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Writes the printer file

tools.name: find_printers
tools.description: Finds the printers on your network

tools.name: send_to_printer
tools.description: Sends a written file to a printer on your network

prompts.name: prepare_for_print
prompts.description: Prepare a model for print, asking for the printer and resin
prompts.text: Prepare ${arguments.model} for print on my resin printer. It is for: ${arguments.purpose}. Ask me which printer and resin I use first.

prompts.name: prepare_miniature
prompts.description: Prepare a miniature by the miniatures recipe and show how it stands
prompts.text: Prepare the miniature ${arguments.model} for the table with the miniatures recipe. Show me how it stands before you write the file.

prompts.name: exposure_test
prompts.description: Find the right exposure for a resin with a test print
prompts.text: Help me find the right exposure for my resin: ask which printer and resin I use, then write an exposure test print.

prompts.name: failed_print
prompts.description: Find out why a print failed, from its file's check
prompts.text: My print of ${arguments.file} came out wrong: ${arguments.what_went_wrong}. Read it against the file's check and tell me what to change.

app.title: Encrust window
app.description: The Encrust program to start when no window is open. Leave it empty where Encrust is installed in its usual place.

timeout_s.title: Time limit, s
timeout_s.description: How long one step may run before it is stopped. A large hollow model needs more.
